# Aberroth Boss Guide

by VolcaLast Updated: May 1, 2026

### Advertisement

This website is supported by ads.

Aberroth is a pinnacle boss in Last Epoch. This guide covers the rewards, boss mechanics and strategies for defeating this boss.

Challenging Aberroth requires progressing through the Forgotten Knights questline and slaying all 10 Harbingers. Spend one Harbinger Eye at the Altar of Oblivion near the back of the Shattered Road to open a portal to face Aberroth.

This boss also has a stronger Uber version, which is accessed through the Threshold of Eternity Woven Echo. This Woven Echo only drops from Aberroth.

## Ability Breakdown

Aberroth Boss Guide

##

### Timeshattering Slam

Aberroth casts Absorbing Chaos to charge up for 4.5 seconds, then uses Timeshattering Slam to create a large increasing circle which deals massive Void and Physical damage. Get in as much as damage as possible and move out before the attack goes off.

### Persisting Void

Orbs that move from side to side. If you get hit by them, they leave behind Persisting Void which deals Void damage. The pools have infinite duration but can be cleared with a Superheated Black Hole.

### Void Beam

Void Beams target you for 2.5 seconds and then fire at your location, dealing Void damage and applying Frailty of Aberroth. They persist between phases, so the longer the fight lasts, the more beams you'll have. Place them side-by-side: north and south of the arena are great places for them, leaving a lot of room for the final phase.

### Superheated Black Hole

Superheated Black Hole is cast at your location after 1.5 seconds, dealing a small amount of Fire damage and applying Ignite. Use it to clear pools of Persisting Void from the ground.

### Superchilled Black Hole

Superchilled Black Hole is cast at your location and deals moderate Cold damage. It also draws in Cold projectiles which deal a small amount of damage and apply Chill.

### Triple Flail Slam

Aberroth creates three triangles and then slams them one by one, dealing very high Void and Lightning damage. The boss first slams the area in the middle, then right and left (from the boss's perspective).

- The easiest way to handle this ability is by moving to the safe area behind the boss.
- You can also sidestep it by first standing in the left or right areas, then moving to the middle after the slam.
- Rogues can use Silver Shrouds to dodge it.
- With strong defenses, you can simply facetank it.

### Slam + Ground of Destruction

Aberroth slams the ground, dealing high Physical and Void damage. It creates Ground of Destruction in the same direction as the slam, which deals high Void damage over time.

### Called Meteors

Aberroth stays in place, calling multiple meteors towards him for 3 seconds. The meteors deal high Fire damage and apply Ignite. When the channeling begins, move to the side or behind the boss to avoid it.

### Lobbed Meteors

Medium-range lobbed meteor attack that deals high Cold damage and applies Frostbite.

### Roots

Roots lock you in place for a short duration. Use movement abilities or a Cleanse to get out of it.

### Blade of Chaos

Aberroth casts Blade of Chaos from its location, which travels in a wide arc. It deals moderate Physical, Lightning and Void damage.

### Cursing Scythe

Aberroth releases a total of 4 Necrotic bolts to deal damage and apply Curse of Aberroth, which reduces All Resistances by 10% and cannot be cleansed.

### Cosmic Absorption

Aberroth charges up Cosmic Absorption for 2.5 seconds and then releases Lazer of Death for massive Void damage. Move out of the charging area, then sidestep the Lazer.

## Boss Mechanics

Aberroth Boss Guide
- Frailty of Aberroth:
- 5% less damage per stack.

- 10% less health leech, ward retention, and health regen per stack.
- 50% reduced healing effectiveness per stack.
- Unlimited stacks, duration 4 seconds.
- Inflicted by multiple abilities, but Void Beams and Quicksand apply most of it.

- Curse of Aberroth:
- Reduces All Resistances by 10%.
- Cannot be cleansed. Unlimited stacks, duration 1,000,000 seconds.
- Inflicted only by Cursing Scythe.

### Phase 1 (100% - 77%)

Aberroth gets access to new abilities in each phase. On phase transitions, it gains 90% less damage taken and stun immunity for 4.5 seconds.

Aberroth uses the following abilities in phase 1, most of which are also used in all other phases:

- Timeshattering Slam
- Persisting Void
- Void Beam
- Triple Flail Slam
- Slam + Ground of Destruction
- Superchilled Black Hole
- Superheated Black Hole
- Blade of Chaos
- Regular attacks: Melee Attack, Charge, Flail Dash, Backward Hop

### Phase 2 (77% - 63%)

- In addition to previous abilities, it now uses Called Meteors, Lobbed Meteors and Roots.
- Called Meteors and Lobbed Meteors are used in phase 2 and 3.
- Roots is only used in phase 2.

- Uber Aberroth: A Harbinger spawns at the start of this phase.

### Phase 3 (63% - 49%)

- Creates four quadrants, each with detrimental ground effects: Quicksand, Lightning, Winds and Fiery Ground.
- Quicksand applies Frailty of Aberroth.
- Lightning applies Shock of Aberroth, which makes you take 5% increased damage per stack.
- Winds applies Chill of Aberroth, which reduces movement speed, attack speed, and cast speed.
- The safest one to stand on is usually Fiery Ground, as long as you have enough sustain. It deals a small amount of Fire damage.

### Phase 4 (49% - 35%)

- Uses Cursing Scythe which applies Curse of Aberroth. Avoid getting hit by it at all costs.
- Uber Aberroth: A Harbinger spawns at the start of this phase.

### Phase 5 (35% - 0%)

- Uses Cosmic Absorption to charge up for 2.5 seconds and then deal massive damage with Lazer of Death. Move out of the charging area, then sidestep the Lazer.
- Absorbing Chaos has a duration of 3 seconds instead of 4.5 seconds, which makes Timeshattering Slam happen faster.
- The boss arena is much smaller in this phase, making positioning even more important.
- Uber Aberroth: Heals to full health at the start of this phase.

## Uber Aberroth

Aberroth Boss Guide
In addition to the regular Aberroth encounter, there is also an Uber version available in the Threshold of Eternity Woven Echo, which is a guaranteed drop from regular Aberroth. You need at least 500 Corruption to place it in your Echo Web.

To defeat Uber Aberroth, you need to master all the boss mechanics and execute them well. Your character should be able to beat regular Aberroth without any effort before attempting the Uber.

In addition to its massively higher health and damage, the following changes also make the Uber version a much harder encounter:

- Orbs that leave behind Persisting Void are faster and created much more frequently. Avoid them as much as possible, and use Superheated Black Hole to remove Persisting Void.
- Void Beams apply a beam to both sides. Since the fight lasts much longer, placing Void Beams correctly is necessary to get through the final phase.
- A Harbinger spawns at Phase 2 and Phase 4, making the boss immune until you defeat it.
- Aberroth heals to full health at the start of Phase 5.

## Summary

Aberroth Boss Guide
- Challenge Aberroth by completing the Forgotten Knights questline and slaying all 10 Harbingers.
- Keep the boss arena clean by clearing pools of Persisting Void with Superheated Black Hole.
- Place Void Beams correctly to get through the final phase.
- Build strong defenses against Void and Physical damage to survive the encounter.
- Master the fight and defeat Uber Aberroth in the Threshold of Eternity Woven Echo to gain access to powerful exclusive Uniques.
